writeup: Santa's Workshop's 12-inch Making Spirits Bright Santa, a hand-painted resin figure in a plaid shirt holding a beer mug and pretzel, is $21.99 at Woot. Art Brand Studios, Wild Wings and Thomas Kinkade Studios all list the same piece at $54, so this is about 59% less. Woot limits it to 3 per order.
